items.seatHold: PK=EVENT#<eventId> SK=SEAT#<n> | holdId, userId, expiresAtMs, expiresAtEpoch
items.hold: PK=HOLD#<holdId> SK=META | eventId, userId, seats[], expiresAtMs, expiresAtEpoch

accessPatterns: hold a seat: PutItem EVENT#e/SEAT#n IF attribute_not_exists(PK) OR expiresAtMs < now
confirm/release: GetItem HOLD#h, then conditional updates per seat (holdId match)
_design.why: conditional writes give exactly-one-winner per seat without Postgres row locks; TTL cleans up abandoned holds; the expiry check in the condition doesn't wait for TTL's lazy deletion
